responsibility: Defines BPF inline-assembly register classes and registers, including the 64-bit and alu32 register views, supported operand types, and overlap relationships between each rN register and its wN subregister.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/bpf.rs` and `spec/base/bpf.rs`, this BPF file is the inline `asm!` register description, defining `rN`/`wN` classes, supported operand types, and overlap between 64-bit and alu32 views.
